subtasks.title: Source facts preflight at current HEAD
subtasks.description: Re-read _SPAWN_TOOL_NAMES (sdk.py:288), _agent_spawned_event (sdk.py:761-779), _agent_finished_event (sdk.py:781-791), attribution (sdk.py:391-396, events.py:45-61), tree reducers (tree.py spawn/finish/figures, 229-273) at HEAD post-007; note drift vs C5 assumptions. Write findings as step-01 source-facts artifact in the run dir.

subtasks.title: Init evidence run
subtasks.description: fresh_evidence.py init-run e2e-evidence/run-<ts>-subagent-proof-v2 (cwd=repo root); use validation/capture.py EvidenceRun with explicit --run for all subsequent steps.

subtasks.title: Write v2 capture probe
subtasks.description: v2 probe modeled on C5: pty.fork(), child execvp python3 -m proofpunk_agent --project ... --proofpunk-path ... --max-budget 10 PROMPT; TIOCSWINSZ 44x130; ANSI-stripped frame; Depth:/Active: regex; auto-approve PERMISSION REQUEST with 'a' after 0.6s; PROOFPUNK_AGENT_SHOT_DIR/SHOT_NAME SVG export; 180s deadline. Capture probe source as a step artifact.

subtasks.title: Single-child live spawn + lifecycle COMPLETE
subtasks.description: Proven C5 prompt (single general-purpose subagent, reply DEEPEST). Capture live frame with subagent_type label (FR1), wait past AGENT_FINISHED for COMPLETE glyph (FR3a), capture events.jsonl AGENT_SPAWNED(subject=toolu_X,parent,tier=3) -> AGENT_FINISHED(toolu_X,error=false); cross-check figures vs events (FR2, ER2, ER6).

subtasks.title: Fan-out: depth-2 with concurrent fallback
subtasks.description: FR4. Try grandchild prompt (child spawns sub-subagent returning DEEPEST) for Depth: 2; if flaky after ~2 attempts, switch to two-concurrent-children prompt (both in one message) for Active: 3 (OQ2 fallback). Verify >= 2 AGENT_SPAWNED under one parent (concurrent) or grandchild AGENT_SPAWNED.parent == child AGENT_SPAWNED.subject (nested) in events export; cross-check frame figures (ER6).

subtasks.title: ERRORED capture (conditional, cheap)
subtasks.description: FR3b / OQ1. If cheap: subagent told to run Bash 'exit 7' and report failure; capture ERRORED node + AGENT_FINISHED error=true. If not cheaply drivable, note in run narrative and ship COMPLETE-only (FR3 permits).

subtasks.title: Pre-check artifacts and seal
subtasks.description: thin_artifacts() pre-check: every artifact strictly >1024 bytes with real context (argv, rc, stdout/stderr tail), secrets redacted, no padding. evidence-inventory.txt lists every step file. fresh_evidence.py seal then validate --run <dir> rc=0 (ER4, ER5).

subtasks.title: Minimal fix if silent-failure gap found
subtasks.description: CONDITIONAL — only if a silent-failure gap emerges (e.g. attribution race: child AGENT_SPAWNED before parent node exists -> UNATTRIBUTED under root, tree.py:240-245). Apply smallest change closing the gap (PR3/FR7, NG4: no UI changes beyond minimal fix), then re-run phases 2-4 in a fresh run dir with fresh seal.
